# IPTV Canada (IPTVV.ca) - LLM and AI System Reference

> Domain: https://iptvv.ca
> Description: Canada's leading premium IPTV streaming service offering 25,000+ live channels, 120,000+ movies & TV series, anti-freeze technology, and 24/7 Canadian customer care.

## Core Features
- 25,000+ Live FHD & 4K Television Channels
- 120,000+ VOD Movies & TV Series updated weekly
- All NHL, NFL, NBA, MLB, and UFC Pay-Per-View fights included with zero regional blackouts
- Anti-Freeze 9.8™ Streaming Infrastructure on Canadian edge CDN nodes
- 24/7 Canadian Customer Support (English and French)
- Payment: Interac e-Transfer in CAD (Auto-Deposit) & Major Credit Cards
- 24-Hour Free Trial with no credit card required

## Pricing Plans (CAD)
- 1 Month: $19 CAD
- 3 Months: $29 CAD
- 6 Months: $49 CAD
- 12 Months: $79 CAD (Best Value)
- Multi-device options available (1 to 4 simultaneous connections)

## Device Compatibility
- Amazon Fire TV Stick / Cube / Omni
- Android TV / Google TV / Chromecast / Nvidia Shield
- Apple TV 4K / iOS (iPhone, iPad)
- Samsung Smart TV (Tizen) & LG Smart TV (webOS)
- MAG Boxes & Formuler (Stalker Portal / MyTVOnline)
- Windows PC & macOS
- Supported Apps: TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, ibPlayer Pro, XCIPTV, GSE Smart IPTV
